map.依据《建筑灭火器配置设计规范》计算配置数量与灭火级别: Computes the required quantity and fire rating from the Code for Design of Fire Extinguishers
map.📖 查看「灭火器配置计算（GB 50140） 使用指南」: View the Extinguisher Configuration Calculation (GB 50140) User Guide
map.灭火器最大保护距离/配置基准（GB 50140）: Maximum protection distance of the extinguisher / configuration baseline (GB 50140)
map.严重危险级：单具最小 3A，每 A 最大保护面积 50 m²: Severe hazard level: minimum 3A per unit, maximum protected area per A of 50 m2
map.中危险级：单具最小 2A，每 A 最大保护面积 75 m²: Medium hazard level: minimum 2A per unit, maximum protected area per A of 75 m2
map.轻危险级：单具最小 1A，每 A 最大保护面积 100 m²: Light hazard level: minimum 1A per unit, maximum protected area per A of 100 m2
map.需配灭火级别 Q = K · S / U: Required fire rating Q = K · S / U
map.灭火器数量 N = ceil(Q / 单具灭火级别): Number of extinguishers N = ceil(Q / single extinguisher rating)
map.E 类（带电）火灾场所按其所在场所的 A 类（或 B 类）危险等级确定配置基准，: Class E (electrical) fire places take the configuration baseline from the hazard level of the place they are in (Class A or Class B), and non-conductive extinguisher types should be selected (such as carbon dioxide or dry powder). For Class B/C fires refer to GB 50140 Table 6.2.2.
map.灭火器配置设计中，由火灾危险等级、保护面积与单具灭火级别，计算需配级别与具数。: In extinguisher configuration design, the required fire rating and number of units are computed from the fire hazard level, the protected area and the single extinguisher rating.
map.按严重/中/轻危险级对应不同单具最小级别与每 A 最大保护面积。: Severe, medium and light hazard levels correspond to different minimum single-unit ratings and maximum protected area per A.
map.每个计算单元不少于 2 具，并合理分散到多个配置点。: Each calculation unit has at least 2 units, reasonably distributed over several configuration points.
map.算例：中危险级、面积 300 m²、K=1.0、单具 2A: Worked example: medium hazard level, area 300 m2, K=1.0, single unit 2A
map.需配级别 Q = K×S/U = 1.0×300/75 = 4.0 A；数量 N: Required fire rating Q = KxS/U = 1.0x300/75 = 4.0 A; number N = ceil(4.0/2) = 2 units (>=2); 1 configuration point x 2 units per point = 2 units. Formula: Q=K·S/U, N=⌈Q/single rating⌉.
map.算例：轻危险级、面积 600 m²、单具 1A: Worked example: light hazard level, area 600 m2, single unit 1A
map.Q = 1.0×600/100 = 6.0 A；N = ⌈6.0/1⌉ = 6: Q = 1.0x600/100 = 6.0 A; N = ⌈6.0/1⌉ = 6 units; configuration points = ⌈6/5⌉ = 2, each with ⌈6/2⌉ = 3 units, totalling 6 units. When the single-unit rating is below the minimum required for the level, check against the minimum rating.
map.危险等级如何影响配置？: How does the hazard level affect the configuration?
map.严重/中/轻危险级对应 U（每 A 最大保护面积）分别为 50/75/100 m: Severe, medium and light hazard levels correspond to U (maximum protected area per A) of 50/75/100 m2 and minimum single-unit ratings of 3/2/1A. The higher the level the smaller the protected area and the higher the single-unit requirement, so the count increases accordingly.
map.为什么每个单元不少于 2 具？: Why at least 2 units per unit?
map.防止单具失效或一处火点邻近灭火器无法取用。规范要求每个计算单元至少 2 具，并分: To prevent a single unit failing or extinguishers near a fire point being unreachable. The code requires at least 2 units per calculation unit, distributed over several points at 2-5 units per point, balancing accessibility and redundancy.
map.依据 GB 50140 计算建筑灭火器需配灭火级别与数量，给出配置点建议，支持危: Computes the required fire rating and quantity of building extinguishers from GB 50140, gives configuration point suggestions, and supports hazard levels and correction factors.
map.自动校核最小灭火级别: Automatic check of the minimum fire rating
